en: Hello {contact}, please accept deliverable {name} or send your comments by {decide_by}. If something is unclear, call me and we will go through it together.
mt: Als er iets onduidelijk is, bel me dan en we gaan het samen door.

en: Hello {contact}, the handover session on {item} for {project} is planned for {due}. Please confirm who attends from {to_whom}.
mt: Hallo {contact}, de overhandiging sessie op {item} voor {project} is gepland voor {due}.

en: Hello {contact}, the benefits review for {project} is on {review}, in about {months_left} months. Please keep the latest figures for {benefit} ready.
mt: Hallo {contact}, de voordelen beoordeling voor {project} is op {review}, in ongeveer {months_left} maanden.

en: Hello {tester}, test cycle {cycle_id} ({cycle}, round {round}) on {project} starts on {date}. Please prepare {planned} cases and the test data.
mt: Hallo {tester}, testcyclus {cycle_id} ({cycle}, ronde {round}) op {project} begint op {date}.

en: Hello, deliverable {name} on {project} has waited {waiting} days for the client. The decision was due by {decide_by}. Please call {contact}.
mt: Hallo, de aflevering {name} op {project} heeft {waiting} dagen gewacht op de klant.

en: Hello, closure task "{task}" on {project} is owned by {owner} and is due on {due}. It is {days_late} days late if it shows a number. Please check it.
mt: Hallo, het sluitingswerk "{task}" op {project} is eigendom van {owner} en is verlopen op {due}.

en: Hello {sponsor}, benefit "{benefit}" of {project} is at {achieved} of the planned level. The next review is on {review}. Please look at the actions needed.
mt: Hallo {sponsor}, het voordeel "{benefit}" van {project} is op {achieved} van het geplande niveau.

en: Hello {support_owner}, I am sending the access and contacts list for {service} on {project}. Please check your accounts before {start}. Handover items done: {handover_done}.
mt: Hallo {support_owner}, ik stuur de toegangs- en contactenlijst voor {service} op {project}.

en: Hello, milestone {milestone} on {project} was accepted on {accepted_on}. Please invoice {amount} to {contact}. The client terms are {terms} days.
mt: Hallo, mijlpaal {milestone} op {project} werd geaccepteerd op {accepted_on}.

en: Hello, the post-project review response {pr_id} for {project} from {respondent} is ready. Main lesson: {lesson}. Please add it to the library.
mt: Hallo, de reactie {pr_id} voor {project} van {respondent} na het project is klaar.

en: The payment tied to this acceptance is {col:deliverables.payment_due}. The acceptance check shows: {col:deliverables.state}.
mt: De betaling die aan deze acceptatie is gekoppeld is {col:deliverables.payment_due}.

en: Project: {col:defects.project}. Project manager: {col:defects.manager}.
mt: Projectmanager: {col:defects.manager}.

en: Fixed on {col:defects.fixed_on} and retested on {col:defects.retested_on}. The defect was reopened {col:defects.reopens} time(s). The root cause is: {col:defects.cause}, with {col:defects.fix_hours} hours of fix effort.
mt: De fout werd heropend {col:defects.reopens} tijd. De oorzaak is: {col:defects.cause}, met {col:defects.fix_hours} uur van het oplossen van inspanning.

en: The pass rate needed to leave the cycle is {set:pass_exit}. The check shows: {col:cycles.state}.
mt: De passing rate die nodig is om de cyclus te verlaten is {set:pass_exit}.

en: To: Finance partner, telephone {col:payments.fin_phone}. Project: {col:payments.project}. Milestone {col:payments.pay_id}: {col:payments.milestone}.
mt: Aan financieel partner, telefoon.

en: The milestone was accepted on {col:payments.accepted_on}. Please invoice {col:payments.amount}, which is {col:payments.share} of the contract price, to {col:payments.contact}, telephone {col:payments.phone}.
mt: De mijlpaal werd geaccepteerd op {col:payments.accepted_on}.

en: The client terms are {col:payments.terms} days. The invoice number is {col:payments.invoice_no}, sent on {col:payments.invoice_date}, due on {col:payments.due}. The payment check shows: {col:payments.check}.
mt: De klant is in {col:payments.terms} dagen. Het factuurnummer is {col:payments.invoice_no}, verzonden op {col:payments.invoice_date}, verschuldigd op {col:payments.due}.

en: Support is taken over by {col:transition.support_owner}, telephone {col:transition.support_phone}, from {col:transition.start}. The handover status is {col:transition.status}.
mt: De ondersteuning wordt overgenomen door {col:transition.support_owner}, telefoon {col:transition.support_phone}, van {col:transition.start}.

en: Of the handover items for this project, {col:transition.handover_done} are done. The readiness check shows: {col:transition.state}.
mt: De voorbereidingscontrole toont aan: {col:transition.state}.

en: The measure is: {col:benefits.measure}. The baseline is {col:benefits.baseline} and the final target is {col:benefits.target}. The benefit is live from {col:benefits.since}.
mt: De maat is: {col:benefits.measure}. De basislijn is {col:benefits.baseline} en het einddoel is {col:benefits.target}.

en: The budget now is {col:projects.budget_now} and {col:projects.spent} was spent. The rework share of effort is {col:projects.rework_share}.
mt: Het budget is nu {col:projects.budget_now} en {col:projects.spent} is uitgegeven.

en: Ratings from 1 to 5: schedule {col:ppr.schedule}, cost {col:ppr.cost}, scope {col:ppr.scope} and client {col:ppr.client}. The overall rating is {col:ppr.overall}.
mt: Ratings van 1 tot en met 5: schema {col:ppr.schedule}, kosten {col:ppr.cost}, reikwijdte {col:ppr.scope} en klant {col:ppr.client}.

en: Main lesson: {col:ppr.lesson}.
mt: Belangrijkste les:

en: Scope covered: {col:warranty.scope}. The warranty runs from {col:warranty.start} to {col:warranty.end}. {col:warranty.days_left} days are left and {col:warranty.used} of the period is used.
mt: De garantie loopt van {col:warranty.start} tot {col:warranty.end}. {col:warranty.days_left} dagen zijn over en {col:warranty.used} van de periode wordt gebruikt.

en: {col:warranty.claims} claim(s) were made so far. The warranty check shows: {col:warranty.state}.
mt: De garantiecontrole toont aan:

en: Please sign and return a copy. Thank you for working with {col:projects.manager} and the project team.
mt: Alstublieft tekenen en een kopie terugsturen.
